[EN] You try to deny it, but it haunts you...now and forever.
[ES] Intentas negarlo, pero te persigue... ahora y para siempre.

[EN] The hero of the entire world...
always the first to come to the rescue.

Always the first covered in blood.[Look into your memory.]"I'm ready to face my regrets.""I'm not ready yet."
[ES] El héroe de todo el mundo...
siempre el primero en acudir al rescate.

Siempre el primero cubierto de sangre.[Look into your memory.]"I'm ready to face my regrets.""I'm not ready yet."
